interview.question: Decide all eight recommendations independently, with separately attributable redacted evidence and exceptions, never one shared outcome. For G01.01, review service-specific pre-production incident plans, shared responsibilities, roles, escalation, prioritization, containment/recovery and original-time exercise/lessons evidence; legacy benchmark wording is qualified by current MCSB IR guidance. No incidents or personal contacts are retained and no exercise is run. For G01.02, substantiate verify-explicitly, least-privilege and assume-breach objectives across identities, endpoints, applications, infrastructure, networks and data, including workload and non-landing-zone responsibilities; a resource checklist is not Zero Trust maturity. For G02.05, distinguish integrated public-CA automation (currently DigiCert/GlobalSign), nonintegrated CA signing/merge workflows and self-signed regeneration. An imported certificate, expiration notification or vault is not automated public-CA renewal, deployment or successful adoption by consumers. For G02.06, separately review key generation/rotation, certificate renewal and consumer updates, ownership, lifetimes, service-specific refresh/old-version overlap and tested failure/recovery paths. Native key rotation is not import of externally generated HSM material; Managed HSM is key-only, not a certificate vault. For G02.09, distinguish vault instantiation/control-plane authority from data-plane access, actual team delegation/PIM/conditions/deny constraints and exact reviewed Policy definitions/versions/assignments/scopes/exclusions/exemptions plus timely compliance evidence. No referenced definition is fetched or rule interpreted. For G02.10, retain immutable MMK wording and current platform/service-managed terminology, default MMK versus requirement-driven CMK decisions per service/data set, dependencies, availability and recovery ownership. Storage keySource is only an explicit narrow setting; Blob/Files differs from Queue/Table Account versus Service key type, infrastructure encryption is separate and Terraform inline CMK presence/absence cannot reconcile separate CMK resources. Storage's versionless daily refresh is not key rotation or proof that consumers have updated. For G02.11, independently determine whether an accountable organizational sovereignty requirement mandates CMK; no geography, encryption setting or external-key-management preview establishes legal eligibility or sufficient sovereignty. For G02.12, review every required service/feature/SKU/cloud/region, Key Vault versus Managed HSM support, key origin/BYOK/algorithm/size/lifecycle and end-to-end availability/consumer integration against current service-specific references. A general support-table Yes or blank is not universal BYOK compatibility. All coverage, requirements, ownership, operation and exception decisions stay blank until explicitly supplied. No key/certificate/secret/URI/issuer/principal/incident/private payload retention, live probes, scans, queries, credential/key/renewal/rotation changes, contact or incident exercises.
